targets: every live fighter in the enemy back row (the front row if the back is empty)
stagger: the tell plays on every target at once; the hit clips go top to bottom, 2 frames (160 ms) apart; a target waiting its turn holds the tell's last frame
shake: on a bite; when two bites overlap the earlier one keeps the shake
dodged: on a Fall Back dodge play it at the row's old spots with no cues: it bites sand
